name: partition_world_object_update_ptrs
facts: Copy all 32 descriptor pointers at 0x310E..0x318E to scratch 0x31AA..0x322A before partition writes.

Read state pointer from descriptor+0 and flags from state+25. Bit6 takes precedence and appends at front in input order. Otherwise bit7 writes backward from 0x318E, reversing admitted order. Neither flag appends to deferred scratch at 0x322A.
Reverse-copy deferred records into the middle, then sort only that middle by unsigned WORD descriptor+6 (world Y). Tie stability is not asserted.
All four tested families conserve the 32-pointer multiset and retain the original input snapshot in copy scratch.
limits: No-deferred input was not tested or claimed reachable; the reverse-copy body has no initial empty-count guard.
Tests do not establish every reachable mutable-state combination, rendering lifetime or IRQ safety.
